data.overview: During a frantic shift at an Ohio fast-food restaurant, manager Sandra receives a call from someone claiming to be a police officer. He says a young employee stole from a customer, and his escalating instructions test how far authority alone can make people go.
data.tagline: How far would you go for a voice on the phone?
